The story

From curiosity to Sawini.

Long before Sawini became a brand, I was curious about hair oils. I mixed different oils, experimented, researched and watched what they did to my hair. Then I asked myself: why keep searching for the right oil when I could make my own?

The first batch taught me what not to do. I went back, reformulated, tested again on myself, then with friends and family. What began as curiosity became a commitment to creating hair care I could stand behind.

From curiosity to Sawini.
